# fluxLab.dev — Full Context for LLMs

> Kyiv-based software development outsourcing company and product studio. Custom web & mobile development, dedicated teams, staff augmentation. 46K+ users, 800+ companies.

## Company Overview

fluxLab.dev is a software development outsourcing company and product studio based in Kyiv, Ukraine. We combine two strengths: we build and operate our own SaaS products (7 live products, 46K+ users), and we help clients build theirs using the same battle-tested stack and processes. Every architecture decision, deployment pipeline, and optimization we recommend has been proven in production on our own products first.

### Why Companies Outsource to fluxLab.dev

1. **Product builders, not just coders** — We think in user flows and business metrics, not just tickets. Our own products serve 46K+ users, so we understand what "production-ready" actually means.
2. **Senior-level team** — Small team of experienced developers (8+ years average). No juniors rotated through your project.
3. **Full ownership** — One team from design to deployment. No hand-offs, no gaps, no miscommunication.
4. **European timezone** — Kyiv, Ukraine (GMT+2/+3). 6-8 hours of overlap with US East Coast, full overlap with EU.
5. **Competitive rates** — Senior developers at Eastern European pricing. Dedicated teams from $8K/month.
6. **Transparent process** — Shared repos, weekly demos, direct Slack access. You see every commit and decision.
7. **Fast delivery** — 8-week MVP cycle from idea to paying customers.
8. **Battle-tested stack** — React, Next.js, Go, Node.js, PostgreSQL — same stack powering our 46K+ user products.

### Services

**Development Outsourcing**
Dedicated development teams of 2-5 senior developers embedded in your workflow. Ideal for long-term product development and ongoing feature work. Starting from $8K/month.

**Staff Augmentation**
Individual senior developers who plug into your existing team. Perfect for filling skill gaps fast. From $4K/month per developer.

**Custom Software Development**
End-to-end development of web and mobile applications. Fixed scope, clear milestones, predictable budget. Best for well-defined products with a known deadline. Starting from $15K.

**Technical Consulting**
Expert guidance on architecture, technology choices, and best practices. Includes architecture review, technology assessment, performance audit, and security analysis.

## Products in Detail (Proof of Expertise)

### FluxRadar — Website Audit for SEO & AI Search
- URL: https://fluxradar.net
- Status: Active (launched September 2026)
- Users: 1,400 | Companies: 90
- Description: Pay-per-scan website audit. Reads a public site the way Google, AI assistants and visitors see it and returns one plain-language report ranked by what to fix first, with a copy-ready message for the developer. Ten modules: SEO (27 deterministic checks), AI search visibility / GEO (AI-crawler readiness plus whether Claude and ChatGPT mention the business), security (passive OWASP ASVS profile), performance (PageSpeed Insights + CrUX), accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), reliability, content quality, privacy, UX/conversion and analytics (Search Console, Google Analytics, Bing Webmaster). One-time pricing: free homepage check, Basic $39, Complete $87. English and Ukrainian.
- Tech: React, Vite, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Docker, Hetzner Cloud
- AI: Claude and OpenAI by default, Gemini and Perplexity optional

### Cursopus — AI-Powered Job Application Tracker
- URL: https://cursopus.com
- Status: Active (launched January 2025)
- Users: 15,300 | Companies: 210
- Description: Personal job search management platform. Chrome extension imports jobs from any website. AI (Claude) parses job details via layered approach (JSON-LD, DOM, LLM). Resume builder with AI-generated summaries. Cover letter generation. Application tracking with list and Kanban views. Analytics: funnel visualization, time-in-stage, resume effectiveness, source performance.
- Tech: Go (chi, pgx), Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Hetzner Cloud, Caddy
- AI: Claude API (Haiku for parsing, Sonnet for generation)

### WashFlow — Business Management Suite
- URL: https://washflow.app
- Status: Active (launched May 2024)
- Users: 8,700 | Companies: 120
- Description: All-in-one management platform for car wash and laundry businesses. Order tracking, scheduling, CRM with loyalty programs, role-based access control.
- Tech: React, Next.js, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, React Native, Docker

### Market — Orders, Receipts & Analytics
- Case study: https://flux-lab.dev/en/projects/market
- Status: Active
- Description: ReceiptMaster brings products, orders, PDF receipts and sales analytics into one workspace. Receipt templates: Standard, Compact and Thermal.

### LifeSpan — Your Life, Visualized
- Case study: https://flux-lab.dev/en/projects/lifespan
- Status: Beta
- Description: A personal life timeline: record days and moods, organize chapters, and keep memories in context.

### EFluxCom — Product in Development
- Case study: https://flux-lab.dev/en/projects/efluxcom
- Status: In development
- Description: An e-commerce product in development. Details will be shared when it is ready.

## Templates

Ready-made bases we adapt to a client's brand and needs instead of building from scratch.

### AutoFlow — Car Dealership Storefront Template
- Live demo: https://autos-sale.com
- Case study: https://flux-lab.dev/en/projects/autoflow
- Description: Storefront and admin panel for a car dealership or used-car lot. Catalog with filters (make, model, body, fuel, gearbox, drive, price, year, mileage), car pages with gallery, specs, options and a credit calculator, favorites and comparison, call/message/test-drive leads. Admin roles (admin, editor) with an audit log; consignment sales with percent or fixed commission; prices in USD, UAH or EUR normalized to a base currency; automatic posting of new cars to up to 10 Telegram channels; photos processed into WebP, AVIF and JPEG renditions. Branding lives in site settings, so each client's copy is rebranded by configuration.
- Tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ, S3, Docker, Hetzner Cloud

## Technical Expertise

**Languages:** TypeScript, Go, SQL
**Frontend:** React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native
**Backend:** Go (chi, pgx), Node.js, NestJS
**Databases:** PostgreSQL 16, Redis
**Infrastructure:** Docker, Hetzner Cloud, AWS, Caddy, GitHub Actions, Terraform
**AI Integration:** Claude API (Anthropic) — layered approach, model selection by task complexity

## Development Process

8-week MVP cycle:
1. Discovery & Scoping
2. Database-first design
3. API-first development
4. Parallel frontend/backend
5. Testing (80%+ coverage)
6. Security review
7. Docker deployment with CI/CD
8. Launch & iteration
